name: AI Usage
author: Akshay Bapat; derived from AkitaOnRails
description: Every configured AI provider's quota at once, as precision circular dials and figures in the bar.

barWidget.description: One circular dial per provider with its mark centered inside, a pace tick, and the percent used. Click a cell for its usage panel.

schema.label: Show the percentage next to each mark
schema.description: Off leaves a strip of marks and dials. "sign in" stays, and the tooltip still has the numbers.

schema.label: Show the quota ring around each provider
schema.description: The circular ring fills clockwise as the plan is used, with a pace tick where the plan's window is known.

schema.label: Compact strip
schema.description: Dials and marks only, for a crowded bar or a long list of providers.

schema.label: Providers to show
schema.description: Comma-separated ids from ai-usagebar usage --json, for example 'anthropic,openai,cursor'. This both filters and orders the strip. Leave blank for every configured provider in the engine's own order.
